title: Penetration Tester
description: A roadmap for ethical hacking and penetration testing with networking, Linux, web security, recon, exploitation, reporting, and legal boundaries.

tree.name: Ethical Hacking Foundations
tree.description: Learn networking, Linux, scripting, web basics, vulnerability classes, legal scope, and responsible disclosure.

children.name: Networking, Linux, and Scripting
children.description: Use TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, Bash, Python, Kali tools, permissions, services, and safe lab environments.

children.name: Scope, Ethics, and Methodology
children.description: Define rules of engagement, test windows, prohibited actions, evidence handling, and reporting expectations.

tree.name: Web Application Testing
tree.description: Test web apps for auth, access control, injection, XSS, SSRF, file upload, business logic, and API flaws.

children.name: Burp Suite and OWASP Top 10
children.description: Use proxying, repeater, intruder basics, request manipulation, auth testing, and vulnerability verification.

children.name: API Penetration Testing
children.description: Test REST/GraphQL APIs for broken auth, object-level access control, mass assignment, rate limits, and injection.

children.name: Practice: Web Finding Writeup
children.description: Exploit a legal lab bug, capture evidence, rate risk, and write remediation steps.

tree.name: Network and Infrastructure Testing
tree.description: Perform recon, scanning, enumeration, password testing, exploit validation, privilege escalation, and pivoting in labs.

children.name: Recon and Enumeration
children.description: Use Nmap, DNS tools, service banners, directories, SMB/SSH/HTTP enumeration, and attack surface notes.

children.name: Exploitation and Privilege Escalation
children.description: Validate vulnerabilities safely, document proof, escalate privileges in labs, and avoid destructive actions.

tree.name: Reporting and Portfolio
tree.description: Write professional findings with impact, evidence, risk, reproduction steps, remediation, and executive summaries.

children.name: Professional Reports
children.description: Create concise reports, screenshots, CVSS context, business impact, remediation guidance, and retest notes.

children.name: Project: Vulnerable Lab Assessment
children.description: Test a legal lab app/network, find vulnerabilities, exploit safely, document evidence, and publish a polished report.
